method: Thirteen names across nine sectors plus two index sleeves, built with the current book as the null hypothesis: all eight held survivors (SPY, VTI, MSFT, AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, LLY, SHEL) are RETAINED and only re-weighted — SHEL's and the megacaps' verdicts are all businessOk:true, and SHEL's phase-out reverses at zero cost because nothing was ever sold — while MA and V carry over from the prior target still undeployed, so the only taxable exits are JPM and GE, which complete their two-strike phase-out by failing to return from adversarial verify for a second consecutive cycle; I cannot claim either thesis is broken, only that neither was re-verified, and that is the single place this allocation spends turnover (~$2,090, which funds the defensive floor). The megacap-tech complex lands at 40.7% of book — 32.0% direct (MSFT 9.5 / AMZN 9.5 / GOOGL 7.0 / NVDA 6.0, every one trimmed from its held weight on entryQuality 3-5) plus 8.7% look-through via SPY/VTI — against the 48% cap, and the defensive floor is met EXPLICITLY rather than by index accident at 17.5%: 14.5% direct in JNJ 7.5% (pharma, 0.38 range/price) and KO 7.0% (staples, 0.30 — the tightest vol in the book), plus ~3.0% through the index sleeves, versus the 15% floor; LLY is deliberately NOT counted as ballast at a 0.48 range and is vol-capped to 6.5%. Posture is de-concentration without abandoning the mandate — payments 11.9%, pharma 14.7%, energy 6.9%, all well inside their caps — with poor entries expressed as SIZE (MA 6.0% vs a prior 7.79%, V 5.5% vs 7.48%, BKNG held to the 5% floor) and reachable near-spot bands rather than deep zones that would strand cash, and NVDA's 6.0% takes no new money until the 2026-08-26 print clears the deploy planner's own earnings blackout. | risk-adjusted (finalize-target.mjs: correlation-cluster + vol-scaled caps) | 5.0% gold diversifier added structurally AFTER synthesis (mandate sleeve — the sleeves cannot score bullion), so percentages quoted in the summary above predate it; the defensive/diversifier/cluster fields are authoritative

names.thesis: Uncapped index ballast and the book's beta anchor — the one sleeve the correlation caps never trim, and the diversifier every cluster cap is measured against; trimmed slightly from the held 20.04% to fund the defensive floor.

Second index sleeve and the executor's waiting ground (PARK_VEHICLE) — total-market ballast tracking a different index than SPY, so the two are never substantially identical for wash-sale purposes; nudged up from the held 3.11% to absorb residual weight rather than concentrate it.
